name: GirlFilter
tagline: Create a girl-version portrait from a photo with an AI filter
description: GirlFilter is an online AI photo filter for creating a girl-version portrait from an uploaded photo. It is for people who want a playful image transformation using a picture of themselves. The product works in a browser and does not require a separate app download. GirlFilter is Freemium, with free and paid options. Check its official website for the current free allowance, pricing and terms before use.
